name: miniOrange Digital Identity Login
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
Digital Identity Login is a powerful WordPress plugin that enables users to log in using their digital identity from various digital wallets.

Supporting multiple wallets like Dock.io and Microsoft Authenticator, this plugin provides a smooth and secure login experience.

It uses cutting-edge protocols like DIDComm, OpenID Connect, OpenID for Verifiable Credentials (OpenID4VC), and OpenID for Verifiable Presentations (OpenID4VP), ensuring a secure and decentralized identity management system.

Furthermore, it upholds eIDAS compliance, making it ideal for websites requiring strong and legally compliant digital identity verification services.

Installation: Secure Your Login with Digital Identity Verification

This section describes how to install the Digital Identity Login plugin and integrate digital identity verification for a more secure login experience on your WordPress site.

Two Easy Installation Methods:

1. Using your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Digital Identity Login. Locate and install the plugin developed by miniOrange.
  3. Once installed, activate the Digital Identity Login plugin.

2. Manual Installation from WordPress.org:

  1. Download the Digital Identity Login plugin.
  2. Unzip and upload the mo-digital-identity-login directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Go to your WordPress Plugins page and activate the Digital Identity Login plugin.

FREE VERSION FEATURES

This free version of the plugin empowers you to leverage the power of Decentralized Identity for secure and user-friendly login experiences –

  • Flexible Digital Identity Integration: Integrate a variety of decentralized wallets including Dock.io and Microsoft Authenticator to provide users with flexibility and convenience in logging in using their preferred digital ID.
  • Secure Decentralized Verification: Verify digital credentials in a secure and decentralized manner, ensuring that only authenticated users with a verified ID can access your website. This eliminates the risk of centralized data breaches.
  • Seamless User Experience: Offer users a secure login experience that is both seamless and user-friendly. Minimize friction during the authentication process, allowing users to log in quickly and easily with their digital identity.
  • Advanced Authentication Protocols: Utilizes advanced authentication protocols like DIDComm, OpenID Connect, OpenID4VC, and OpenID4VP to ensure secure communication and data exchange within the decentralized identity management system.
  • eIDAS Compliance: Ensure compliance with the eIDAS (Electronic Identification, Authentication, and Trust Services) regulation, providing legally recognized electronic identification for online services across EU member states.
  • Simple Setup and Configuration: Simple setup and configuration process, enabling administrators to easily integrate and manage digital identity logins without extensive technical knowledge.

Supported Digital Wallets

  • Microsoft Authenticator
  • Dock.io

Third parties APIS

  • https://uniresolver.io API is used to resolve decentralized identifiers (DIDs) into DID Documents for identity verification. (Terms of Use – NA)
  • https://verifiedid.did.msidentity.com API is used to verify the credentials of the users from Microsoft Authenticator. (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy)
  • https://api-testnet.dock.io API is used to verify the credentials of the users from Dock Wallet. (Terms of Use, Privacy Policy)
sections.faq:
What is a digital ID?

Digital identity is the online or networked identity adopted or claimed in cyberspace by an individual, organization, or electronic device. It is a set of data that uniquely describes a person or a thing and contains information about the subject’s relationships.

What is Digital Identity Login?

Digital Identity Login allows users to log in using their digital identity from various decentralized wallets. It supports multiple wallets and leverages advanced authentication protocols to provide a secure and seamless login experience.

What are verifiable credentials?

Verifiable credentials are digital certificates that can be cryptographically verified by third parties. They contain information asserting certain attributes or qualifications of the holder, such as age, citizenship, or educational achievements, and can be securely shared and verified online.

Which wallets are supported by Digital Identity Login?

The plugin supports multiple decentralized wallets, including Dock.io and Microsoft Authenticator.

How does Digital Identity Login ensure secure authentication?

Digital Identity Login utilizes advanced authentication protocols such as DIDComm, OpenID Connect, OpenID for Verifiable Credentials (OpenID4VC), and Verifiable Presentations (VP) to ensure secure and decentralized identity verification.

How are digital credentials verified?

Digital credentials are verified using cryptographic methods that ensure the credentials are authentic and have not been tampered with. This typically involves checking the digital signature of the credential against the issuer’s public key, ensuring the integrity and authenticity of the credential.
